description: This file declares the DrmMetricsLogger class, which implements the IDrm interface for DRM metrics logging in Android. It includes enums for DRM status codes and security levels, and defines methods for DRM session management, property handling, and security features.

classes.name: DrmMetricsLogger
classes.description: Implements DRM metrics logging and session management, providing methods for DRM operations such as session handling, key management, property access, and security level queries.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the DRM system is properly initialized.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given crypto scheme (UUID) is supported.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a DRM plugin instance for a specific UUID and app package.

methods.name: destroyPlugin
methods.description: Destroys the current DRM plugin instance.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a new DRM session with specified security level.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes an existing DRM session.

methods.name: getKeyRequest
methods.description: Generates a key request for license acquisition.

methods.name: provideKeyResponse
methods.description: Provides a response to a key request, typically license response.

methods.name: removeKeys
methods.description: Removes keys associated with a key set ID.

methods.name: restoreKeys
methods.description: Restores keys for a session using a key set ID.

methods.name: queryKeyStatus
methods.description: Queries the status of keys in a session.

methods.name: getProvisionRequest
methods.description: Gets a provisioning request for device provisioning.

methods.name: provideProvisionResponse
methods.description: Provides a provisioning response.

methods.name: getSecureStops
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop data.

methods.name: getSecureStopIds
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs.

methods.name: getSecureStop
methods.description: Retrieves a specific secure stop.

methods.name: releaseSecureStops
methods.description: Releases secure stops.

methods.name: removeSecureStop
methods.description: Removes a specific secure stop.

methods.name: removeAllSecureStops
methods.description: Removes all secure stops.

methods.name: getHdcpLevels
methods.description: Gets HDCP levels for a session.

methods.name: getNumberOfSessions
methods.description: Retrieves current and maximum number of DRM sessions.

methods.name: getSecurityLevel
methods.description: Gets security level for a session.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseKeySetIds
methods.description: Retrieves offline license key set IDs.

methods.name: removeOfflineLicense
methods.description: Removes an offline license.

methods.name: getOfflineLicenseState
methods.description: Gets the state of an offline license.

methods.name: getPropertyString
methods.description: Retrieves a string property.

methods.name: getPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Retrieves a byte array property.

methods.name: setPropertyString
methods.description: Sets a string property.

methods.name: setPropertyByteArray
methods.description: Sets a byte array property.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metrics.

methods.name: setCipherAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets cipher algorithm for a session.

methods.name: setMacAlgorithm
methods.description: Sets MAC algorithm for a session.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data within a session.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data within a session.

methods.name: sign
methods.description: Signs data within a session.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a signature within a session.

methods.name: signRSA
methods.description: Performs RSA signing within a session.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for DRM events.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoder
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder is required for a MIME type.

methods.name: setPlaybackId
methods.description: Sets playback ID for a session.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves DRM log messages.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemes
methods.description: Retrieves supported DRM schemes.

methods.name: reportMediaDrmCreated
methods.description: Reports creation of a DRM instance.

methods.name: reportMediaDrmSessionOpened
methods.description: Reports opening of a DRM session.

methods.name: reportMediaDrmErrored
methods.description: Reports a DRM error.

methods.name: generateNonce
methods.description: Generates a nonce for DRM operations.
